title: G5 · 拒绝
body: I replaced the odd-only prime sieve with a cache-sized segmented wheel-30 sieve that cuts candidate scanning and expensive bit read-modify-write marks, while upgrading matMul from a 1×4 to a cache-blocked 2×4 register tile that halves transposed-B loads and reuses each loaded B value across two rows. These changes target the two slowest tasks without touching the six stable exports, with the sequential accumulation, arbitrary-size tails, dense Float64Array output, and general prime boundaries preserved; the substantially lower prime work and improved matrix locality should provide the margin needed to clear the 5% acceptance threshold.
